# `liber:balloon-device@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:balloon-device` package (`balloon-device.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem memory balloon - the contract a `memory-balloon` provider serves: what a virtual machine's host asks to have back, and the allowance ResourceManager grants against it.  THE HOST ASKS AND THE MACHINE DECIDES. The host sets a target - how many pages it wants back - and the balloon holds the smaller of that and the allowance its one consumer, ResourceManager, grants; the kernel adds its own floor under both. Only FREE pages are ever given - never one a process, a buffer or a device holds - so no Domain is ever made to give anything up for the host, and when the machine needs memory again its policy lowers the allowance and the balloon gives pages back to it first.  IN PAGES OF 4 KiB, the unit the device counts in.
